title: Ami the Oven-man
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in [Moed Katan 11a](https://www.sefaria.org/Moed_Katan.11a.3): Rav Yehudah permitted Ami the Oven-man to build ovens during the intermediate festival days. Rashi on the Rif explains that he was an oven-keeper. It is not known whether he was a Torah scholar.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The source prints עם where the syntax means “whether.” Its Hebrew is retained; scholarly status remains explicitly unknown.

The linked Gemara distinguishes the summer and rainy seasons when discussing oven construction. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=585&lang=en) repeats the permission and his uncertainty about Ami’s scholarly status. Hyman attributes the gloss “oven-keeper” to Rashi on the Rif.
